title: Workflows screen: read smurf-server workflow graphs
Settings: Smurf models, router ranking and benchmarks panel
brief:
The desktop app (React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind, folder desktop/) has a Settings modal (desktop/src/components/SystemPreferencesModal.tsx) whose Models tab renders the old <ModelsManager .../> component (around line 364). That component calls endpoints the new backend does not have. Replace it with a new read-only panel for the new backend (smurf-server).

1. Create desktop/src/services/smurfApi.ts. Use `serverJson` from './serverUrl' (signature: serverJson<T>(path: string, fallback: T): Promise<T>; it adds auth and returns the fallback on errors). Export types and functions:
  type SmurfModel = { key: string; adapter: string; model: string; tier: 'light'|'standard'|'strong'|'premium'; free: boolean; billing?: string; contextLength?: number; modes: string[]; cooling?: { reason: string; until: string } };
  fetchModels(): Promise<{ models: SmurfModel[]; skipped: string[]; refreshed?: string }>  -> GET /api/models (fallback { models: [], skipped: [] })
  type RouteCandidate = { key: string; score: number; why: string; parts: Record<string, number> };
  fetchRoute(category: string): Promise<{ candidates: RouteCandidate[]; dropped: Record<string, number> }> -> GET /api/route?category=<category> (fallback { candidates: [], dropped: {} })
  type BenchmarkRun = { id: string; date: string; passed: number; total: number; rows: { task: string; category: string; model: string; pass: boolean; sec: number }[] };
  fetchBenchmarks(): Promise<BenchmarkRun[]> -> GET /api/benchmarks (fallback [])
  Also export a pure helper groupByAdapter(models: SmurfModel[]): Record<string, SmurfModel[]> (adapter -> models sorted by key).
2. Create desktop/src/services/smurfApi.test.ts (vitest) testing groupByAdapter (grouping and sorting) with at least 2 tests.
3. Create desktop/src/components/SmurfModelsPanel.tsx (default export or named export SmurfModelsPanel, no props). Three sections, clean and compact, matching the app's existing light Tailwind style (look at ModelsManager.tsx for class names to reuse):
  a) 'Models': counts per adapter, then a table per adapter (model, tier, billing/free, cooling badge with reason if cooling). A Refresh button re-fetches.
  b) 'Router ranking': a <select> of categories [coding, debugging, testing, research, review, architecture, docs]; shows the top 10 candidates with score (2 decimals), the 'why' text, and small bars or numbers for parts (benchmark, correctness, tools, context, latency, cost).
  c) 'Benchmarks': list of runs (date, passed/total) with an expandable row table (task, category, model, PASS/FAIL, seconds).
  Show a short loading state and an empty state; never throw.
4. In SystemPreferencesModal.tsx, render <SmurfModelsPanel /> instead of <ModelsManager ... /> for the models tab and remove the now-unused ModelsManager import and props from that file only if they become unused. Do not change other files.

title: Agents list: map smurf agent profiles
brief:
In the desktop app (folder desktop/), desktop/src/services/agentApi.ts fetchAgents() calls GET /api/agents. The new backend (smurf-server) returns a bare JSON array of agent profiles:
  type SmurfAgentProfile = { id: string; category: string; name: string; mode: 'edit'|'readonly'; minTier: string; timeoutMin: number; review: string; description: string };
Today fetchAgents ignores that array and shows only the built-in agent.

Change agentApi.ts:
1. Export a pure function `profileToAgent(p: SmurfAgentProfile): Agent` mapping to the app's Agent type (import type { Agent } from '../types' - read desktop/src/types.ts and fill every REQUIRED field of Agent with sensible values: id = 'smurf-' + p.id, name = p.name, a description/markdown-like field = p.description plus a line 'Category: <category>, mode: <mode>, min tier: <minTier>, review: <review>'; for any field naming an agent type/engine use the string 'smurf'). Mark it read-only if the Agent type has such a flag.
2. fetchAgents(): if the response body is an array, map it with profileToAgent and pass the result to mergeAgentsWithBuiltin (keep the existing behaviour for the old `{agents}` shape and for unsupported responses).
3. saveAgents(): if the server answers 404/405 (use isUnsupported(response) already imported), resolve without throwing.
4. Create desktop/src/services/agentApi.test.ts (vitest) with at least 2 tests for profileToAgent (id prefix, name, description contains the category).
Do not change other files.
